featured_reviews.name: Sachin Gotal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Kalyan Jewellers at Seawoods Mall with a lot of excitement and trust, as my wife and I have been loyal Kalyan customers for years. We have bought jewellery multiple times from Kalyan Jewellers in Bangalore, so we walked in expecting the same warmth and respect.
Sadly, what we experienced was extremely hurtful and disappointing. The salesperson showed zero interest in helping us. She barely showed any designs and constantly made faces whenever we asked to see jewellery. Instead of assisting us, she kept discouraging us by saying the jewellery “wouldn’t look good” on us... without even showing it. As customers, we deserve the basic courtesy of being shown the options and allowed to decide for ourselves.
We walked out feeling ignored and disrespected.
We immediately went to Tanishq, where the difference was night and day. The staff there treated us with patience, respect, and genuine care, and we ended up making our purchase there.
Today, Kalyan Jewellers lost not just a sale, but two loyal customers...my wife and me. I have also purchased jewellery for my parents from Kalyan in the past, but after this experience, I will never return. This visit completely broke our trust in the brand.

featured_reviews.name: Chandani Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with my experience with Peora. I ordered the product expecting good quality based on the pictures and description shown online, but the actual product was very different. The design did not look as elegant as shown and the finishing was also not good. The material felt cheap and not worth the price I paid.
The packaging was average and the product did not give the premium feel that was advertised. I was really expecting better quality because the pictures on the website looked very attractive, but the real product did not match those expectations.
Also, I do not understand why cleaning charges are being taken. This was not clearly mentioned earlier, and it feels unfair to charge customers extra for cleaning. Such additional charges should be clearly informed before purchase.
Overall, I am not satisfied with this purchase and experience. I hope Peora improves their product quality and is more transparent about extra charges so that customers are not disappointed.
